name: aromir_flat_hydroxy_cf3_pyridine
purpose: TASKS 248, 16 Nov 2026: `aromir spectrum` end to end on Oc1cncc(C(F)(F)F)c1 (15 atoms, corpus B_0f06474656) with the rule for flat coordinates (saved optimiser progress, geomeTRIC's Q-Chem-style test after 100 gradients, the step off a saddle point sized from its curvature, a flat coordinate printed and named): a real, positive soft mode (9.51 analytic, 15.82 measured; a CF3 rotor). Read against the corpus's B3LYP positions and its label's soft mode (probes/results_m1/aromir_e2e_2026-11-16/end_to_end_against_corpus_b3lyp.py). In WSL from ~/aromir_dev (the code of ~/aromir-src as checked out at launch, its commit on the log's second line; pyscf 2.15.0), capped by probes/wsl_capped.sh beside the live training.
command: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 wsl -e bash -c "export OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PYTHONUTF8=1 PYSCF_TMPDIR=/home/thebreadishard/qc_tmp TMPDIR=/home/thebreadishard/qc_tmp; mkdir -p /home/thebreadishard/qc_tmp; cd /mnt/c/Users/thebr/Documents/CapstonePlan/plans/05_delta-probed-ir-pipeline && echo '=== (AROMIR) start' && git -C /home/thebreadishard/aromir-src log --oneline -1 && bash probes/wsl_capped.sh 4096 -- /usr/bin/time -f '(AROMIR) max RSS %M kB, wall %e s' /home/thebreadishard/aromir_dev/bin/aromir spectrum 'Oc1cncc(C(F)(F)F)c1' --out probes/results_m1/aromir_flat_2026-11-16/hydroxy_cf3_pyridine --threads 8 --max-memory-mb 2048; echo '=== (AROMIR) done: hydroxy_cf3_pyridine'"

estimate.basis: 16 Nov, aromir on 8 threads beside the training: benzene 559 s, benzonitrile 1,435 s, 3-vinylfuran 4,029 s with two optimisations (the second 100 steps) and one Hessian; a second Hessian adds about 23 min for 13 atoms, and fluorine or 18 atoms more basis functions
